card.name: Inside brand names and capitalized words
card.fires_on: Partway through a brand drug name written in capitals or a long capitalized word, such as HERNEXEOS, RYBREVANT, MOTOFEN, ZEVTERA. Also in all-caps warning text, where a word is split such as FREQUENT or GREATER.

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug brand name, often when the name is repeated in the text.

modes.label: All-caps warning words
modes.description: A piece inside a word in an all-capitals boxed warning or heading.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of drug brand names and capitalized warning words, before the name is finished.
